messages:
Maya - Marketing: Quick check — webinar next Wed 10am PT. Need final X + LinkedIn thread plan and who owns inbound routing. Who can pick up assets?
Alex - Growth: I can own scheduling. Need final copy by EOD Tuesday. Will do A/B on CTA. :mag: 
Sam - Content: Drafts ready, sending variants now. Two X threads: 1) product angle 2) benchmark narrative (cost/latency wins). Which gets priority?
Maya - Marketing: Prioritize benchmark narrative for LinkedIn, product angle for X. We want the benchmark to land in peak hours on LinkedIn (noon ET).
Sam - Content: Got it. Uploading assets to drive: https://drive.redwood/invite-assets/WEB-042.json (contains GIF, 1-min clip, 3-card carousel).
Alex - Growth: For scheduling: planning to post X thread at 9:30am PT, LinkedIn at 12:00 ET, reminder tweet at 45m before. Tentative cron-ish plan:
```
X thread: 2026-04-15T09:30:00-07:00
LinkedIn: 2026-04-15T12:00:00-04:00
Reminder X: 2026-04-15T09:45:00-07:00
```
Rachel - SDR Ops: For inbound routing — please ensure the registration form has UTM params and a hidden field to tag channel=organic_social. We need to send leads to the SDR queue with priority flag for 'webinar_high'.
Maya - Marketing: Rachel — can you confirm the webhook mapping? We need near-real-time routing to the dedicated SDR Slack channel.
Rachel - SDR Ops: Yep. I'll add mapping: utm_source=xlnk_webinar, utm_campaign=benchmark_launch, tag->queue:webinar_high. Also adding a short script to dedupe by email.
Alex - Growth: Also want to experiment with pinned comment approach on X to surface the registration link versus CTA in first tweet. Sam — can you prepare two CTA lines: one direct sign-up, one curiosity-driven?
Sam - Content: Done — variants are in the drive. Example X opener: 'We cut inference cost 3x and kept latency <100ms — here's how.' Variant B: 'Why inference economics is the real product moat — join our webinar.'
Maya - Marketing: Nice. For engagement follow-ups: plan 1) Live thread replies during webinar, 2) 24h recap post + short clip, 3) nurture email to registrants. Rachel — SDR cadence after webinar?
Rachel - SDR Ops: 24h: outreach email + LinkedIn connect message if lead opened recap. 72h: follow-up sequence, tag 'hot' if attended + asked question. Will share template.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Schedule posts" in #marketing at 2026-04-14T10:00:00Z. :bell:
Alex - Growth: One more ask — can we add tracking tokens for creative variants so we can attribute engagement to GIF vs clip vs carousel? UTM creative=gif/clip/carousel.
Sam - Content: Added suffixes to each asset link; I'll label the filenames: WEB-042-gif, WEB-042-clip, WEB-042-carousel.
Maya - Marketing: Great. Final checklist: Sam final copy by EOD Tue, Alex schedules posts, Rachel confirms webhook & SDR templates, ops-bot reminder set. If anyone needs extra amplification slots (paid boost), tell me today. :rocket:
Alex - Growth: I'll ping paid team if we decide. Otherwise organic schedule stands.
Sam - Content: Uploading alt text and suggested comment replies for the live thread now.
Rachel - SDR Ops: Mapping done, will test with staging webhook at 4pm today and report back.
Maya - Marketing: Perfect. Thanks team — let's sync tomorrow AM if anything breaks. :coffee:
